title: Knoxville Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Need a campsite? We have plenty of options! Need an RV site with a patio? Want to pitch a tent & stay close to nature? Is cabin glamping your idea of camping? Knoxville Campground has a variety of RV site options. Need a 50-amp hookup? We have it. Need sewer, water, and electric? We have it. Our sites are big rig friendly, and we also have pull through spots for easy in and out. services.name: Campfire Banana Boats
services.desc: A favorite among camping families, banana boats are easy to make and endlessly customizable. Simply slice a banana down the middle, fill it with chocolate chips, marshmallows, and your favorite toppings, wrap it in foil, and warm it over the fire. The result is a gooey, delicious dessert that many campers remember
